name: TreeRow
intent: Presentational hierarchical row with indentation and an expand/collapse affordance for tree-structured lists.
when: Render a bespoke nested/tree list outside a data table

chooseOver.because: DataTable's getSubRows tree model is for tabular data with columns; TreeRow is a standalone row primitive for custom hierarchical lists

commonMistakes.mistake: Mix TreeRow with DataTable getSubRows for the same data
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Mix TreeRow with DataTable getSubRows for the same data — choose one tree mechanism (see fm-dt-3)
